name: 1 · Contained repricing
trigger: Capex guidance slows; stress stays in Oracle, neoclouds and chips.
description: AI valuations reset but credit holds outside the weakest borrowers. Quality names linked to AI demand get marked down with the theme; the rest of the market rotates rather than crashes.

name: 2 · Credit event
trigger: A neocloud default or an OpenAI funding gap; private-credit losses; Fed still hiking on oil.
description: Circular commitments start failing. Forced selling hits everything with liquidity — including gold miners — before quality and havens separate from the pack.

name: 3 · Global recession
trigger: The IMF ‘triple whammy’ plays out: equity, debt and promised revenue fall together, plus an oil shock.
description: Wealth effect drags consumption and investment. Base metals follow industrial demand down; gold and low-cost producers keep positive margins but their shares still fall first.
